cohort: 152 uterine specimens from obstetric hysterectomies and maternal autopsies, compared to 152 control specimens from hysterectomies for abnormal uterine bleeding
finding: Physiological uterine changes during pregnancy and the postpartum period follow specific timelines, with decidual change present from 6 weeks gestation to 16 days postpartum, myometrial hypertrophy present from 8 weeks gestation to 30 days postpartum, and myometrial preischemia observed from 20 weeks gestation to 16 days postpartum.
mod_finding: Cervical wall hemorrhages were significantly associated with vaginal delivery (84.84% of cases) compared to lower segment cesarean section (17.64% of cases).
